verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a public API v2 that covers the core scheduling lifecycle: querying slots, creating bookings (regular, recurring and instant), rescheduling, creating event types and schedules, and webhooks. It authenticates via OAuth or API key in the Authorization header, and an agents guide frames the API for AI-driven use. A probe confirms the API docs are served as machine-readable markdown. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the standard paths probed (all 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
